arg.name: unitree_sdk
arg.description: Unitree SDK of the hardware plugin: [3_8_0, 3_3_1]

arg.name: robot_ip
arg.description: Low-level UDP server of the robot (port 8007), SDK 3.8.0 only

arg.name: power_limit
arg.description: Safety::PowerProtect factor, 1-10 (10-100 % of the power): over it the SDK cuts the motors

arg.name: contact_threshold
arg.description: footForce above which a foot is in contact

let.name: legged_robot_description
let.value: $(command 'xacro $(find-pkg-share legged_unitree_description)/urdf/robot.xacro robot_type:=$(var robot_type) camera:=$(var camera) lidar:=$(var lidar) sim:=false unitree_sdk:=$(var unitree_sdk) robot_ip:=$(var robot_ip) power_limit:=$(var power_limit) contact_threshold:=$(var contact_threshold)')
